role: Triple Slash body: a white crescent slash. Three fly level to the target together in a ">" formation (the middle one leads, the others 36 px behind and 36 px above / below; techFx flyFormation). Faces right, not rotated.

first_frame.description: a sharp white crescent-shaped sword slash wave flying to the right, the curved outer edge faces right, thin blade-like crescent with a bright white core and pale blue edges, a few speed streaks trailing to the left, dark navy outline, pixel art game effect sprite, single object centered, transparent background

animation.description: a white crescent sword slash shimmers in place, a bright glint runs along its edge, the small sparkles behind it flicker and drift backwards, the crescent keeps the same shape, size and position, seamless looping animation

note: Frames 1-3 carry a glint running along the edge (bottom, right, top), then back to frame 0. The animation added two armor-like greys (#7f7d7a, #807e7b, 37 px); every pixel was snapped to the palette above, so no grey matches the hero's armor. Alpha is 0/255 only.
